purpose: Explain drivetrain health proxies, current returned motor readings, thermal indicators and historical power/temperature evidence without treating unknown values as measured zero.
primaryGoal: Assess available thermal/motor evidence for the workspace vehicle and inspect supporting history, source limits and specialist care recommendations.

identity.snapshotKind: Current working-tree source only; no Git operations or historical equivalence claim.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled, retry false, AbortSignal forwarded; page marks provenance inferred. Methodology describes module-temperature proxies, not direct motor measurements. Producer implementation not inspected.
Vehicle-enabled, safeArray, FAST stale time, AbortSignal; page supplies no server window or limit. Local calendar filtering, chronological ordering and last-30 cap feed drive charts/power summary.

Vehicle-enabled, retry false, AbortSignal; unbounded statistics explicitly described as independent of chart range. model.statsSI converts declared km/kmh response fields into display-bridge SI; backend unit comments not independently verified.
Positive vehicle enables query; page requests 5000ms polling; response observation timestamp and source retained.
Positive vehicle enables query, safeArray and AbortSignal; page passes 200 with no bounds. Existing hook supports start/end; motor mapping retains source order and front-or-rear fallback.

REST bootstrap/reconnect recovery and SSE patches supply isolationResistance separately from motor snapshots. Shared live hook returns scalar state and transport connected flag; page does not receive individual isolation trust/observation metadata.

Existing header vehicle/range owner consumed without a duplicate picker. Range adapter exposes exact rolling instants but page only takes calendar dates. DataState retains successful payload on refresh failure and paused/offline status.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Map this adapter to SourceContent plus existing StaleRefreshWarning, retaining independent shells/retries and all body content; do not add another shared boundary.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a local sensor presentation helper if layout changes require it; keep both named sections, source policy and every reading reachable.

findings.detail: Independent drive and stats SourceBoundary calls omit loading; nested power brief also omits loading/empty status. During first load they can show unknown placeholders under Returned evidence rather than Loading source (NestedDrivingBrief.tsx:58-65). DetailPanels.tsx:37,46 repeats the omitted initial state.
findings.fix: Pass each source's initial state and resolved emptiness independently; do not use the health loading flag for drive/stat neighbors. Preserve unknown readings and partial neighbors.

findings.detail: Separate live isolation evidence is inside the motorLatest fatal/loading/empty gate. A missing/failed motor response hides a valid isolation reading; the combined brief only receives the motor query trust state.
findings.fix: Keep the thirteen-field record capability but annotate/render isolation with its own source trust and independent recovery, rather than letting the snapshot query decide its availability.

findings.detail: useState initializes once; SSE and REST updates merge into previous state at lines 471-477 and 497-503, with no vehicle-change reset in this hook. The page stays mounted across workspace selection and displays isolationResistance from that state, so an old vehicle's isolation value can persist until the new vehicle supplies that field.
findings.fix: Shared live-state owner must scope/reset retained state by vehicle identity and retain observation/source metadata. Verify switching from a vehicle with isolation to one without it, including no selected vehicle; do not patch only this scalar with invented zero.

visualIssues.detail: Torque area uses fixed electric cyan #00f0ff at lines 35,45. Other mounted history charts hardcode saturated multi-hue strokes/gradients and reference labels rather than existing chart tokens. Source scan found 22 hex color occurrences.
visualIssues.fix: Consume restrained existing palette/theme chart tokens without resetting saved chart preferences or changing series/thresholds; subdue reference lines, keep primary data distinct and all table/export controls.

visualIssues.detail: Chart tick/reference font sizes are hardcoded to 10px across all four history charts; small text may be difficult to read at narrow allocated widths. Actual readability and contrast were not tested.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing chart typography/tick policy and validate narrow/200%-text views; retain all labels and accessible tables.

architectureIssues.detail: Header range is registered, but useDrives receives no start/end and motor history receives only limit=200. driveSeries filters the already-loaded subset using local calendar dates, not useRangeState precise rolling instants. A rolling 24h selection therefore behaves like inclusive calendar days; server history coverage remains unbounded/default-limited. The scope limits are disclosed but do not satisfy workspace-range semantics.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should use startInstant/endInstantExclusive in typed history hooks and establish complete server-window chart coverage or explicitly bounded subsets. Keep latest snapshot and intentional unbounded statistics distinct; preserve source ordering, existing cap and semantics unless authorized coverage work changes them.

architectureIssues.detail: Inclusive local end at 23:59:59 drops records in the final fractional second of a selected calendar day. This is coupled to the calendar-only local filter above.
architectureIssues.fix: Compare exact lower/exclusive-upper instants from the canonical range adapter, not a page-owned end-of-day string; add final-millisecond and timezone/DST cases.

architectureIssues.detail: Series names and regen table heading hardcode kW while formatPower uses saved unitPrefs.power. Main subtitle/aria label call the measured average-power source peak power although the specialist description correctly explains the alias.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain series IDs and legacy aliases but visibly append selected power unit and average-power provenance; do not rename saved hidden-series keys or reinterpret the measurement.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature dependencies import layout-reference/stat-reference internals directly instead of production category barrels. Scoped source scan found 11 such import statements, including type-only imports; the page's own layout import is canonical.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category exports for presentation components; verify whether required public types are already exported before requesting a barrel extension. Do not replace the existing reference implementation.

priority.reason: Workspace date semantics and possible cross-vehicle live-value retention affect evidence integrity before aesthetic cleanup.

Canonical imports and restrained chart palette

requiredSharedChanges.name: Vehicle-scoped live evidence
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing vehicleId input; scope/reset state by identity; expose known/missing scalar, observation time and retained/offline trust independently of transport connected. Preserve REST bootstrap, reconnect recovery and SSE patch behavior.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Workspace-bound history integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Already available useDrives(vehicleId,{start,end,limit}) and useMotorHistory(vehicleId,{limit,start,end}); consume startInstant/endInstantExclusive. No new range control, query store or unit engine. Complete coverage requires backend/aggregation verification outside this audit.

competingImplementations.name: Local SourceBoundary versus canonical SourceContent
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse existing shared recovery contract where equivalent; retain the nonblocking StaleRefreshWarning companion.

competingImplementations.name: Legacy HealthSummary barrel export versus mounted DrivetrainSummary
competingImplementations.decision: Page mounts DrivetrainSummary. HealthSummary implementation/test bodies were not inspected; do not count their visuals as mounted or remove their functionality on this evidence.

preservation.sectionCountDefinition: Mounted named outer feature surfaces: 6 summary + 2 thermal + 1 live + 4 charts + 1 history-record shell + 3 detail + 1 methodology. Two history tables and nested briefs are not added to this count.
actions: Hidden-series toggles with stator-temp-chart and drivetrain-power-output persistence keys
History table pagination and mobile details
dataBehavior: Preserve all five independent REST queries, vehicle enablement, cancellation, inherited policy and 5000ms latest polling until authorized integration changes.
Keep four health sensor proxies, fixed Celsius ceilings and 65%/85% gauge bands; good/warning/critical score mapping remains 95/60/25, with no assessment without finite sensor evidence.

Keep all thirteen motor record fields, front/rear torque and axle fallback, source and observation timestamp; nonpositive isolation remains the disclosed existing unknown policy pending shared source contract.
Keep raw nullable SI drive measurements and display-only formatters; do not fabricate regen power or direct motor power-history signals.
Model presently converts declared legacy km/kmh stats and kW snapshots to SI display bridge. Do not silently alter these exceptions based on field names; producer verification is outstanding.
Keep retained data on refresh failure, independent neighbors, specialist proxy/alias disclosures and all recommendation ordering.
Keep chronological last-30 drive cap and source-order 200 motor request documented; range repair needs explicit integration decisions, not accidental deletion or claiming complete aggregates.
